source.check: returned unopposed: 'Downpatrick Rural Council will show only one change—Mr. Wm. T. M'Calla ... in place of Mr. Wm. Glover, J.P., in Kilmore division. There will be no contests' (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026).

note: Triennial election of the Downpatrick rural district council, 1936; polling day for Co. Down, Thursday 4 June 1936. There were no contests and only one change, at Kilmore (Belfast News-Letter, 7 May 1936, p. 15). The unchanged divisions are not named. New member, in place of Mr. Wm. Glover, J.P. Returned unopposed.
